en.title: Maldives and the United States of America sign the tenth amendment to the Development Objective Grant Agreement (DOAG)
en.description: The tenth amendment to the Development Objective Grant Agreement (DOAG) has been signed between the Maldives and the United States of America, today.
en.body:
The tenth amendment to the Development Objective Grant Agreement (DOAG) has been signed between the Maldives and the United States of America, today.

The signing ceremony took place at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, marking a significant milestone in the ongoing partnership between the Maldives and the United States of America. His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs signed the tenth amendment to the DOAG on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Maldives and on behalf of the Government of the United States of America, USAID Mission Director Gabriel Grau signed the agreement.

The DOAG is a landmark development cooperation agreement signed between the Maldives and the United States on 12 March 2019. Over the years, there has been gradual increases in the funding allocated. Through the tenth amendment concluded today, the United States Government has committed an additional USD 7.2 million to the Maldives. The funds will be utilized to strengthen the technical capacity of the Maldives in managing public finances and bolster the resilience of the country's economic and democratic governance. With the signing of the tenth amendment, the total value of funding increases to USD 36.1 million.

The signing ceremony of the tenth amendment of the DOAG was attended by senior officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and USAID Mission to the Maldives.

en.title: Minister of State for External Affairs of India departs from Maldives
en.description: The Minister of State for External Affairs of India, V. Muraleedharan departed today from Velana International Airport after concluding his two-day Official Visit to the Maldives.
en.body:
The Minister of State for External Affairs of India, V. Muraleedharan departed today from Velana International Airport after concluding his two-day Official Visit to the Maldives.

The Minister of State for External Affairs arrived in the Maldives on 3 June 2023 and during the visit the Minister of State called on President of Maldives, His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and reflected on the long bonds of friendship between both countries. The Minister of State also called on Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid and reviewed significant milestones achieved in bilateral relations of both the countries during the past four years. Both Minister Shahid and State Minister Muraleedharan also discussed the ongoing projects under the grants and the lines of credit extended to the Government of Maldives, from the Government of India, through the Export Import Bank of India and High Impact Community Development Scheme. Minister Shahid expressed gratitude to the Government and the people of India for the constant support extended to the Maldives.

During the visit, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid and Minister of State for External Affairs, V. Muraleedharan witnessed the exchange of ten agreements including the Memorandums of Understanding between the Government of Republic of Maldives and Government of India for Development of Arts Centre in Male', Development of Sh. Milandhoo Running Track, Construction of Lh. Hinnavaru New Council Office, Establishment of Mental Health Unit at Abdul Samad Memorial Hospital, Procurement of 4 School Buses for Fuvahmulah City, Kulhudhuffushi City, N. Kendhikulhudhoo and L. Gan, Development of Outdoor Gym in Addu City, Hithadhoo Beyrumathi Dhaairaa, Development of Outdoor Gym in Addu City, Hithadhoo Rasgedhara Dhaairaa, Development of Outdoor Gym in GDh. Vaadhoo, Development of Outdoor Gym in HA. Dhidhdhoo and School Digitalization Programme in L. Atoll Education Centre. The gifting of Antituberculosis medicine from the Government of India to the Government of Maldives also took place during this visit.

The Minister of State for External Affairs also attended the groundbreaking ceremony of Addu City reclamation project and Gan International Airport development project being constructed under the Indian line of credit. In addition, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives and Minister of State for External Affairs of India jointly inaugurated the Hithadhoo Tourism Zone – Falhoadhandifannu, Feydhoo Tourism Zone - Dhigihera and Hulhudoo Tourism Zone - Maafishi developed under Indian grant assistance in Addu City.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a congratulatory message to the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye Dr. Hakan Fidan
en.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives Abdulla Shahid sent a message of congratulations to the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye Dr. Hakan Fidan, today.
en.body:
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives Abdulla Shahid sent a message of congratulations to the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye Dr. Hakan Fidan, today.

Minister's message reads as follows:

"Excellency,

It gives me great pleasure to extend my sincere congratulations to you on your appointment as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye following President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s impressive victory in the Presidential Election of 2023.

The Maldives and Türkiye have a long-standing history of friendly relations marked by mutual understanding, respect, and a steadfast commitment to peace, stability, and development. The official visit by your predecessor His Excellency Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu in January 2022 was a significant milestone in our relations. It paved the way for enhanced cooperation in the areas of trade, agriculture, environment, culture and education. I eagerly look forward to working closely with you to further strengthen these enduring bonds of friendship and cooperation between our two countries.

en.title: Ceremony held to inaugurate Hulhudhoo Tourism Zone
en.description: The inauguration of Hulhudoo Tourism Zone - "Maafishi" developed under Indian grant assistance was held today in Addu City. The Tourism Zone was jointly inaugurated by Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla…
en.body:
The inauguration of Hulhudoo Tourism Zone - "Maafishi" developed under Indian grant assistance was held today in Addu City. The Tourism Zone was jointly inaugurated by Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, Minister of State for External Affairs of India, V. Muraleedharan and Mayor of Addu City, Ali Nizar.

Speaking at the ceremony, Minister Shahid highlighted that the four Tourism Zones inaugurated in Addu City will have a positive impact on the economic development of the respective islands as the Zones will open various opportunities for the people of Addu City. The zones will boost the economy and attract private investments making Addu City into a thriving and modern economic hub in the south of the Maldives. The subsequent result of increased employment opportunities, especially for youth in the most prospective sector of our economy will have a positive impact for the communities of Addu. During the ceremony the Minister of State for External Affairs of India and Mayor of Addu City also delivered a statement.

The three Tourism Zones Hithahdoo -“Falhoadhandifannu”, Feydhoo -“Dhigihera” inaugurated yesterday, and Hulhudhoo- "Maafishi" inaugurated today is valued at 23 million Rufiyaa and has been completed under the High Impact Community Development Projects grant scheme facilitated by the Government of India.

Minister of State for External Affairs, V. Muraleedharan is on an Official Visit to Maldives from 3-4 June 2023.

en.title: Maldives and Sri Lanka will convene the Fourth Session of the Joint Commission, in Colombo
en.description: The fourth Session of the Maldives Sri Lanka Joint Commission will be held in Colombo from 6 – 7 June 2023.
en.body:
The fourth Session of the Maldives Sri Lanka Joint Commission will be held in Colombo from 6 – 7 June 2023.

The Joint Commission will be co-chaired by His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives and His Excellency M.U.M. Ali Sabry, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.

The Ministerial meeting will be preceded by the Senior Officials Meeting which will be held on 6 June 2023.

The Maldives – Sri Lanka Joint Commission was established in 1984 under the Agreement on Economic and Technical Co-operation between the two countries. The Joint Commission provides a platform for the two Governments to review, deliberate and establish cooperation frameworks on areas and issues of mutual importance in bilateral and multilateral spheres.

Topics on the agenda at the Senior Officials Meeting include trade and investment, tourism, culture, education, health, fisheries, defence, legal and law enforcement, youth and regional and international cooperation. Several Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) are scheduled to be signed between the two countries on the margins of the Joint Commission.

The Third Session of the Joint Commission was hosted by the Government of Maldives in Male’, in 2017.

en.title: Maldives elected as Co-chair of Preparatory Committee for the Fourth International Conference on SIDS
en.description: The Republic of Maldives, along with New Zealand, were elected as Co-chairs of the Preparatory Committee for the Fourth International Conference on Small Island Developing States (SIDS), during the organizational…
en.body:
The Republic of Maldives, along with New Zealand, were elected as Co-chairs of the Preparatory Committee for the Fourth International Conference on Small Island Developing States (SIDS), during the organizational session of the Preparatory Committee held in New York, today. The Maldives will be represented by the Permanent Representative of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations, Thilmeeza Hussain. The Preparatory Committee will be overseeing organizational, procedural, and substantive preparations for the Fourth International Conference on SIDS, scheduled to be held in Antigua and Barbuda in 2024.

The Maldives pledges to work towards strengthening cooperation between SIDS and the international community. The Maldives will work with the Preparatory Committee, and the wider international community, to identify priorities for the sustainable development of SIDS. The Maldives is confident in its ability to deliver for all SIDS.

The Fourth International Conference on SIDS will bring together world leaders to agree on a bold new programme of action for SIDS. The programme of action will serve as a guiding light for SIDS towards sustainable development, including the accomplishment of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The Conference will help determine the final implementation gaps and challenges for the SAMOA Pathway, Mauritius Strategy, and Barbados Programme of Action, including a review of the SIDS Partnership Framework.

She has also served as the Permanent Secretary and filled other roles at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Shifana has diverse experience in administration and human resource management. dv.body:
އަލް-އަޤްސާ މިސްކިތަށް އިސްރާއީލުން މެދުނުކެނޑި ދެމުންގެންދާ ހަމަލާތަކާ ގުޅޭގޮތުން މަޝްވަރާކުރުމަށްޓަކައި އޯ.އައި.ސީ.ގެ މައި މަރުކަޒުގައި މިއަދު ބޭއްވި އެ ޖަމުޢިއްޔާގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އޯޕަން-އެންޑެޑް ކުއްލި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން އޯ.އައި.ސީ. އަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު އަދި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން ސައުދީ އަރަބިއްޔާއަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު އަލްފާޟިލް މުޙައްމަދު ޚަލީލް ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެން އެ ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ތަޤްރީރުކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

އެމަނިކުފާނުގެ ތަޤްރީރުގައި އެ އަމަލުތަކަކީ އ.ދ.ގެ ސަލާމަތީ މަޖިލީހާއި ޢާއްމު މަޖިލީހުގެ ޤަރާރުތަކާ ޚިލާފު އަމަލުތަކެއްކަން ބަޔާންކޮށް، އެ ޢަމަލުތައް ހަރުކަށި އިބާރާތުން ކުށްވެރިކުރެއްވިއެވެ. ހަމައެއާއެކު އިސްރާއީލުން ގާޒާގައި ޤަވައިދާ ޚިލާފަށް ހިންގަމުންދާ އަމަލުތައް ހުއްޓުވުމަށްވެސް ގޮވާލެއްވިއެވެ.

އަދި، އެ މަނިކުފާނުގެ ތަޤްރީރުގައި ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ރައްޔިތުން އަބަދުމެހެން ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ރައްޔިތުންނާއެކު ވާނެކަމުގައި ވިދާޅުވެ، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ބިންތަކަށް އިސްރާއީލުން ވެރިވެގަތުން ނިމުމަކަށް ގެނެސް، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ މިނިވަން ދައުލަތެއް ޤާއިމްކޮށް، 1967 ވަނަ އަހަރުގެ ކުރީގެ ބޯޑަރާ ހިސާބަށް އިސްރާއީލުން ފަހަތަށް ޖެހުމަށް ބާރުއަޅާ، ފަލަސްތީނުގެ ދައުލަތުގެ ވެރިރަށުގެ ގޮތުގައި އިރުމަތީ ޤުދުސް އޮންނަން ޖެހޭ ކަމުގައި ވިދާޅުވިއެވެ.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Eritrea
en.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the State of Eritrea, His Excellency Osman Saleh Mohammed, on the…
en.body:
The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the State of Eritrea, His Excellency Osman Saleh Mohammed, on the occasion of Eritrea's National Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It gives me great pleasure to extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Eritrea on the occasion of your National Day.

It is my sincere hope that the friendly relations that exist between the Maldives and Eritrea will continue to flourish in the years ahead.

Let me also convey my personal best wishes for your good health and well-being and prosperity for the people of Eritrea.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Newly appointed Non-Resident Ambassador of Hungary to Maldives calls on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: The newly appointed Ambassador of Hungary to the Maldives, István Szabó paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel, today.
en.body:
The newly appointed Ambassador of Hungary to the Maldives, István Szabó paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel, today.

State Minister Khaleel warmly welcomed Ambassador Szabó and congratulated him on presenting credentials as the Non-Resident Ambassador of Hungary to the Maldives. During the meeting, State Minister Khaleel highlighted the deepened ties of friendship between the Maldives and Hungary, particularly in the past two years following high level visits from Minister Szijjártó to the Maldives in November 2022 and Minister Shahid's visit to Hungary this month. Discussions further focused on expanding trade ties, education cooperation and enhancing people to people ties.

State Minister Khaleel and Ambassador Szabó reiterated commitments to continue the existing cooperation between the two countries in the bilateral and multilateral fora.

State Minister Ahmed Khaleel was accompanied by Secretary, Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed and Desk Officer Aminath Shaistha Hamdan Zaki.

en.title: New Non-Resident High Commissioner of Malaysia calls on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: His Excellency Mr. Badli Hisham bin Adam, Non-Resident High Commissioner of Malaysia to the Republic of Maldives paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, today.…
en.body:
His Excellency Mr. Badli Hisham bin Adam, Non-Resident High Commissioner of Malaysia to the Republic of Maldives paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, today. High Commissioner Badli had earlier in the morning presented his credentials to President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih at a ceremony held at the President’s Office.

At the meeting held in the Foreign Ministry, State Minister Khaleel, congratulated High Commissioner Badli on his appointment and expressed confidence that High Commissioner would serve to reinforce the long-standing brotherly relations between the two countries.

In this regard, State Minister Khaleel and High Commissioner Badli, discussed ways to further strengthen the existing friendly bilateral ties, especially in relation to bilateral trade cooperation, education, sports, and developmental cooperation.

State Minister Khaleel thanked the Government of Malaysia for the kind hospitality extended towards the Maldivian community in Malaysia. State Minister Khaleel noted that Malaysia is a destination of choice for Maldivian students and that Malaysia is a country that hosts one of the largest Maldivian communities. Both also discussed consular matters relating to the Maldivians living in Malaysia and exchanged views on further simplifying the arrangements.

High Commissioner Badli was accompanied by the Secretary and Head of Chancery of the High Commission of Malaysia, Mr.Aneurin Ignatius.

State Minister Khaleel was accompanied by Secretary Bilateral at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Dr. Hala Hameed, Additional Secretary, Mr. Amin Javed Faizal, Senior Undersecretary, Ms. Fathimath Naeema and Assistant Director, Mr. Ibrahim Haail.

en.title: Newly appointed Non-Resident Ambassador of Czech Republic to Maldives calls on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: The newly appointed Ambassador of Czech Republic to the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Eliška Žigová paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel, today.
en.body:
The newly appointed Ambassador of Czech Republic to the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Eliška Žigová paid a courtesy call on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel, today.

During the meeting, State Minister Khaleel congratulated Ambassador Žigová on her appointment and discussed about enhancing cooperation between the two countries, including trade and economic ties and cooperation in the fields of tourism, education, and agriculture. State Minister Khaleel and Ambassador Žigová also reflected on the strong partnership between the two countries in the multilateral fora.

State Minister Ahmed Khaleel was accompanied by Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed and Desk Officer Saifulla Waleed.

en.title: Governor of the People’s Government of Yunnan Province of the People’s Republic of China, His Excellency Wang Yubo calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid
en.description: Governor of the People’s Government of Yunnan Province of the People’s Republic of China, His Excellency Wang Yubo paid a courtesy call on His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, Minister of Foreign Affairs.
en.body:
Governor of the People’s Government of Yunnan Province of the People’s Republic of China, His Excellency Wang Yubo paid a courtesy call on His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, Minister of Foreign Affairs.

Minister Shahid welcomed Governor Yubo and the delegation to the Ministry and noted the long-‎lasting close bilateral ties between the Maldives and China. Minister Shahid highlighted that such visits provide an excellent opportunity to promote exchanges and increase cooperation between the Maldives and the Yunnan Province.

Governor Yubo noted the close relations between the two nations and assured his commitment to work closely with the Maldives in enhancing cooperation to promote economic growth and development.

Minister Shahid and Governor Yubo exchanged views on a wide array of areas and discussed ways of strengthening substantive cooperation in the fields of agriculture, education, sports, tourism, and trade between Maldives and the Yunnan Province.

Minister Shahid also reiterated that the Government of Maldives remains steadfast in its firm commitment to the One China Principle, as articulated innumerable times, since the establishment of diplomatic relations between Maldives and China.

The Minister was accompanied by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Foreign Secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Latheef, Secretary, Bilateral, Her Excellency Dr. Hala Hameed, Additional Secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Amin Javed Faizal and Senior Undersecretary, Ms. Fathimath Naeema.

Governor Yubo is on an Official Visit to the Maldives from 20-22 May 2023, on the invitation of Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid.

en.title: Swiss Ambassador pays a farewell call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: The Ambassador of the Swiss Confederation to the Republic of Maldives, Dominik Furgler paid a farewell call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid, this morning.
en.body:
The Ambassador of the Swiss Confederation to the Republic of Maldives, Dominik Furgler paid a farewell call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid, this morning.

Minister Shahid congratulated Ambassador Furgler on the successful completion of his tenure and thanked him for his hard work in strengthening the friendly relations between the Maldives and Switzerland. Both Minister Shahid and Ambassador Furgler also discussed ways to further strengthen the bilateral ties between the two countries in areas of trade and economic cooperation and reflected on the strong partnership in the multilateral fora.

During the meeting, Ambassador Furgler further informed Minister Shahid of the Swiss Government’s decision to join the VFS Visa Center in Malé and facilitate visa application process for Maldivians traveling to Switzerland, Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Poland, Slovenia and Liechtenstein. Minister Shahid thanked Ambassador Furgler and the Swiss Government for this decision.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Khaleel, Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary, Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary, Economic Cooperation Dr. Hussain Niyaaz and Desk Officer Aminath Shaistha Hamdan Zaki.
